title: Flow Subgraphs and Flow Network Design under End-to-End Power Dissipation Constraints
summary: We investigate how the underlying graph of a network supports a flow between a source node and a destination node and propose to compute the expected number of nodes and links that contribute to transferring items in random graphs. Since the transportation is associated with a \quotes{cost} or \quotes{power dissipation}, we further address how to construct a graph given predetermined end-to-end power dissipation, which can be reduced to the \quotes{inverse effective resistance problem} that asks for a weighted graph in which the effective resistance matrix equals a predetermined demand…
